snippet.description:
Voters are tuning out political labels like progressive and moderate and tuning into individual candidates and their ideas. Vox’s Astead Herndon breaks down why the gap between media labels and voter reality matters for politics leading up to 2028.

Watch the full episode of America, Actually here on YouTube, or listen wherever you get your podcasts.

Subscribe to our channel and turn on notifications (🔔) so you don't miss any videos: http://goo.gl/0bsAjO
